name: Sentora RLUSD Main
oneLiner: senRLUSDv2 is Sentora's RLUSD Morpho Vault V2 share; yield and losses change NAV, and cash redemption depends on idle RLUSD.
collateral: RLUSD lending positions against kBTC, weETH, USDe, cbBTC, FXRP, syrupUSDC and wstETH, plus 1-wei lender dust positions against WBTC, PT-sUSDE-13AUG2026 and WETH at Ethereum block 26197000 (2026-10-15). Allocations change under curator controls; borrower collateral is distinct from the underlying deposited token.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposit/mint and withdraw/redeem exchange shares for RLUSD at the current asset conversion rate. Lending interest, fees and realized losses change NAV. liquidityAdapter() is zero at Ethereum block 26197000; ordinary cash redemptions use idle assets unless assets are first deallocated. Permissionless forceDeallocate has a 0.01% penalty and depends on market liquidity; an in-kind position exit does not promise full-size cash redemption. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum deployment 0x6dc58a0fdfc8d694e571dc59b9a52eeea780e6bf is immutable VaultV2, issuing transferable ERC-4626 operational shares over RLUSD, not a direct fiat or parent-reserve ownership claim. asset(), decimals(), totalSupply(), convertToAssets() and ordinary one-share redeem simulation were reverified at Ethereum block 26197000 (2026-10-15T09:24:59Z); the simulation returned 1014234889118427417 raw RLUSD and is not a settled redemption. The protocol-position archetype intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent. Exact deployment creation: Morpho vaultV2ByAddress creationBlockNumber=24587448, creationTimestamp=1772667719 (2026-03-04T23:41:59.000Z); independently retrieved 2026-10-15.
